method_paragraph: CVC-300: Cross-site Vote-Consensus surface from the 9 focus-site dotted rasters (GEMSDOE24/25/27/28/30/31/32/33/36, local hash-pinned copies in docs/downloads) weighted equally, plus DSLUP-uniq and DARP research rasters as independent-family bonuses, converted to a 300m triangular-kernel submodular CELF emission (alpha=0.2,beta=0.8) at 37654 dots, catalogue pixels excluded, distance-to-catalogue used only as a canary/feature not as hidden-truth leak. Mimic: shared catalogue-hugging bias of all voters (suppressed by excluding <=2px catalogue collar in holdout evaluator and reporting hug share).

experiments.desc: Vote + 0.15*DSLUP + 0.15*DARP bonus CELF, hard cap <=15000 dots within 3px of DSLUP-uniq dots
Vote CELF restricted to sweet band 3-15px from catalogue labels

gates.validator: all-finite float32 EPSG:32611 3730x3292 values in [0,1] everywhere, 0 on-catalogue, zeros outside footprint
gates.holdout: GEMSDOE32-HIDE-RECOVER-v3.0 N withheld reported, plus SGMC-CAL-v3.0; paired vs GEMSDOE32 champion and vs DSLUP-uniq

deviation: Exact CELF allocation timed out after 1700s (no result recorded); switched to repo greedy_disk_allocate 3px disk emitter, same budget/allowed/score. Logged 2026-10-27 KG2-S3.
